task_description: Transform the voice assistant into a live agent that executes actions directly (navigation, direct Firestore writes, field-by-field form filling, TTS responses, continuous listening mode). Changes to functions/index.js (Cloud Function prompt) and src/renderer/renderer.js (frontend agent logic).

verification.summary: Both files pass node --check syntax validation. Three review iterations: v1 found 6 issues (5 fixed), v2 found 2 issues (both fixed), v3 APPROVED. All key functionality implemented: TTS, continuous listening, voice navigation, field filling, direct execution with confidence threshold, tool tracking, modal state sync.
